meta.title: Hillstrom MineThatData
meta.framing: I used a real randomized email experiment first to check that the uplift methods work before building synthetic credit data. Mens E-Mail vs No E-Mail, outcome = visit.

model_overlap.agreement_flag: Moderate overlap. Some shared persuadables, but each model still has a big unique slice. I would not treat either top-decile list as the final answer on its own.

negative_cate.framing: Small group (about 1.4% of the test set), so I would not call this a confirmed effect. Still, the people with negative CATE clustered in higher-history / Rural / Multichannel, and that idea shaped Phase 2 Sleeping Dogs.
